avis.texte: This is an amazing product; my skin felt so smooth and beautiful after just one application. And the smell is so good!
Using this overnight leaves my skin feeling fresh and moisturized. My skin looks fresher, as it is very dry.

Easy to apply with immediate results. I used it once and left it on for 20 minutes. It was easy to remove. My skin felt instantly plumper and appeared glowing. The following day, my skin felt firmer and my fine lines appeared to be fading.
This is a lovely face mask; my skin felt so smooth and glowing.

I slept in this two nights in a row and woke up to a really nourished and fresh face. I will start using some of Skin Chemist's other products to include them while gaining the benefits of this mask. Although I am not vegan, I appreciate the idea that no animals are used in making the product, and I can share the efficacy of this product with friends who are!
I used this the other night and it left my skin feeling fresh and soft; it was amazing!
This is a fabulous product that is a joy to use and yields fabulous results. I would thoroughly recommend it.
The collagen mask is a really good mask. I highly recommend it, as it instantly soothes my skin and smells lovely.

This was a bit confusing because when I purchased this, it said it was a day mask. However, when I received it, the label said it is a night mask. The packaging says to leave it on for 20 minutes, but the tube itself says to leave it on all night. I left it on all night. I put some on my décolleté area and had itchy skin and a rash for a week, so I will only use it for my face in the future.
My skin felt really soft immediately after using the collagen mask. Overall, my skin appears to be clearer and brighter.
This is absolutely brilliant. I have purchased it three times, and I think it is my favorite facial cosmetic.

As a member of the reviewer club, I was able to purchase this collagen mask at a generously discounted price. First of all, the packaging design is aesthetically appealing, and I like the minimalistic feel. This mask is an unscented, clear gel that is easy to apply with either fingers or a brush. The thick consistency allows for a thin, even layer with no mess or dripping. It is pleasantly cooling and feels refreshing on the face. After use, my skin feels plump, soft, and smooth. I think this mask is great. Key ingredients include acacia collagen with firming and nourishing properties, bilberry extract which protects the skin and reduces redness, and gluconolactone which helps smooth the skin. One thing I feel I need to point out is that the directions for use are different on the box and the product tub. One says to leave it on overnight while the other says to wash it off after 20 minutes. I contacted customer service and received a prompt reply assuring me it can be used either way. However, I strongly feel that the instructions should be the same on both the box and the product packaging.
It was so good and hydrating that I left it on overnight and woke up with such glowy skin.
The collagen mask works like magic. It leaves your skin looking radiant. It's amazing.
I am very happy with the collagen mask. It is nice to apply and has very fast absorption. The cream is very good quality.
The collagen mask is easy to use and leaves the skin so soft.

I love the ease of the collagen mask. It comes in a handy tube that is easy to squeeze, providing just the right amount with no mess. The mask feels very nourishing. Afterward, my skin looks and feels brighter, hydrated, and plumper. I love it!
The collagen mask is an amazing product; my skin feels a lot firmer yet soft after using this. I definitely recommend trying it if you haven't already.
This is a beautiful collagen mask that is not harsh on your skin; it is suitable for sensitive skin and leaves you glowing.
I love this collagen mask. My skin feels clean and looks clear, and it smells wonderful.
The collagen mask goes on clear and can be left on all night.

I used the collagen mask for the first time last night. I discovered when applying it that you should not squeeze the tube too hard, as too much product came out and I had to put the extra in a spare container. However, after washing it off in the morning, my skin looked and felt nice. Afterward, I applied the Marine Repair night and day moisturizer.
There was a visible difference even after the first use. I will be ordering again, and I have also recommended it to my friends.
I really like this product. It smells good and is very light when applied to my skin. My face felt smoother and softer in the morning, and I had no issues with the collagen mask.

After using my watermelon cleanser, which I love, I put on the collagen mask. It smells amazing, and you only need a small amount. Twenty minutes is enough time to leave my skin feeling soft and supple. I am going to use the mask on a regular basis to see how my skin improves over time. Updates to follow.

First of all, as you take out the bottle, you are impressed after being impressed by the fast delivery and packaging. After using it twice, I can say that the collagen mask works as it says and is good for sensitive skin too. It didn't at all irritate staying on for 20 minutes as mentioned in the directions.

Coming from someone who has oily skin, the collagen mask completely ruined my skin barrier and somehow managed to make my skin dry and red since I have used it. From using it once, I am desperately trying to get my skin back to normal. I do not recommend this product; it was a waste of my money.

I have only been using the collagen mask for a few days. When I first used it, I think I squeezed the tube a little too hard, so my face was white. A little goes a long way! It did melt into the skin easily, and my skin felt softer. Like with all skincare products, it takes some time to notice a difference; I will update after a month of use.

I have never tried a mask like the collagen mask; it is absolutely amazing and made skincare seem less of a chore. I was slightly confused because the packaging says to leave it on overnight while the bottle says to wash it off after 20 minutes. I quite like using it both ways, and the soft dry down doesn't make a mess.

It seems this collagen mask might be good for other people with non-sensitive skin. As soon as I put it on, it felt good, then a little tingle started, so I rinsed it off quickly. That was not a good reaction! I gave it to my husband to use.
The collagen mask is one of the best moisturizers I have ever bought; it is super hydrating and moisturizing.

The collagen mask arrived in a nice package that was delivered securely. I use this mask in the evening. I applied just a small amount and gently patted it around my face, avoiding the eye area. After ten minutes, I removed it, and my skin felt really nice and soft.

Since I have started using the collagen mask, I have been told that my skin looks more radiant. I love the smell and the fact that after applying the mask, I don't feel bothered by it at all. The best part is that after using the product, I don't feel like my skin is overproducing oils, which is great as well.
The collagen mask made my face feel nice and clean; I will be recommending it to friends and family.
The collagen mask has a lovely smell. My skin looks more glowing after using it. I definitely will keep using it.
After using the collagen mask, my skin feels softer, smoother, and brighter, with very intense hydration.

The collagen mask has a pleasant fragrance that isn't too heavy. It went on smoothly and was easy to sleep in. It seemed to help with fine lines and wrinkles, and I really like this mask. Thanks for making it!

I got this SkinChemists collagen mask and have to say I am absolutely in love with it. The mask was packed nicely in a box, and the tube itself was a vibrant, bright orange color. Upon opening the tube, I instantly smelled a beautiful citrus scent which was delicious. I applied the mask after cleansing and drying my face as instructed and kept it on overnight. Once it had dried, my face immediately felt so smooth. The following morning, I woke up with a bright, refreshed feeling and super soft skin. I would highly recommend this product.
I can see my face getting smooth after using the collagen mask. I love the product.

The SkinChemists collagen mask definitely has a hydrating and firming effect, leaving my skin plump and rejuvenated. It is easy to apply and gentle on my skin, and I can tell that it enhances my overall skin texture. It truly provides noticeable results after just one use.

I loved this product. While it comes out a blue color, it doesn't leave any residue on your skin and sinks in fully, leaving your skin feeling plump, glowy, and full of life. It has most definitely become a part of my weekly skincare routine, and I would 100% recommend the collagen mask.

I was lucky enough to win this on Instagram. As a skincare addict, I was very keen to try it. I loved the product. The texture was perfect, just how I like it, with a very pleasant perfumed aroma. My skin felt a little tight after use, but the results in the morning were lovely soft skin. All in all, I would definitely purchase the collagen mask in the future.
The collagen mask feels great on my skin! This is a very good product, and I would like to try more products from this company.
The collagen mask leaves your skin feeling really soft and smooth, and it smells nice too.
The collagen mask was easy to apply and felt fresh on my skin. It left my skin feeling very soft. I would purchase it again!
I love the collagen mask and I will 100% repurchase it. After just one use, my skin feels fresh and soft. My skin is not irritated by the product, and it smells lovely.
The collagen mask was a good purchase, but the expiration date is near.

The collagen mask made my skin feel softer than before, and my fine lines were less apparent after removing the product. I like the consistency and the feeling on my skin while using it. I am not sure how long the effects on my lines will last, but I will continue to use it.

I am used to masks having a thick, colored consistency, but the collagen mask was a clear gel that seemed more like a face wash. I have given it a try and am pleasantly surprised; my skin felt clean and soft afterward.
This is a luxury-feeling product that left my skin looking healthy. The instructions on the carton are different from the tube, but otherwise I have no complaints about the collagen mask.
I love this mask. My skin feels super soft, and my laughter lines are not as noticeable after using the collagen mask for a couple of days.
As someone who can react to face products, I found this was not one of them. The collagen mask has made a difference to my skin, as it now looks hydrated and my fine lines appear to be reduced.

I will continue to use the collagen mask. I have noticed my skin is much plumper and firmer a day or so after use. It was easy to apply, and the instructions were easy to follow. Alongside the collagen cream I tend to use, they work well together when using the mask then the cream. There is no sticky residue after use either; it's five stars from me.
I love this collagen mask. It really hydrates the skin and fights wrinkles.
The collagen mask is a great mask for hydration and is well worth a try!
The collagen mask is always a delight to purchase from them. Ordering is easy, quick, and no-fuss.
I was lucky to receive the collagen mask to test. It is really refreshing and has a nice smell. It sinks into the skin, and my skin felt soft after use. I would recommend it.
The collagen mask is really easy to use and left my skin looking plump and hydrated.
The collagen mask went okay; it was nice and smooth and not too thick. I left it on overnight and washed it off in the morning, and it left my skin feeling soft.
This product leaves the skin smooth, though it is a bit too heavily perfumed.
This is lovely on my skin. I love the feel of the collagen mask the morning after.
When I put the collagen mask cream on my face, it gave me a lovely tingling feeling. My skin was glowing and smooth, and it looks fresher.

This is a lovely, smooth mask that is lightly scented and glides onto the skin. It feels lovely and hydrating. Unfortunately, I have really sensitive skin and had a minor reaction to this one, so I will be passing it on; however, it seems like a really nice product.

I bought the collagen mask with anticipation and wasn't disappointed! It goes on like a dream, moisturizing my dry/combination skin throughout the day and night. I use this probably every other night after cleansing; my skin feels nourished and soft to the touch. It is better than most expensive brands I've previously tried. I recommend this product.

I've used this mask a couple of times since I received it. It is very light and not greasy at all. It goes on very smoothly, and so far, my skin has looked great after using it. Hopefully, it will look even better with continued use.

I have used the collagen mask quite a few times now, and I am really impressed. My face feels so hydrated, soft, and smooth. I really love Skin Chemists products; they are value for money and a great skin care range.
The collagen mask is easy to use, apply, and take off. It left my skin feeling nourished and refreshed. It will be my weekly staple, and I look forward to great results.

I like the collagen mask. I put a thin layer on my face and neck, and it felt nice and creamy. After 20 minutes, I rinsed my face and patted it dry gently. My skin felt well-refreshed, smooth, and like new.
The collagen mask is a lovely mask with a light scent and a minty freshness. It felt nice and cool on my skin, and it was hydrating. It left my skin feeling clean and fresh.

This is exactly what I was looking for to add to my daily routine, as I have run out of collagen. After the first application, the effect on my skin was visible; it has reduced the appearance of my fine lines. The collagen mask is a really good product.
The collagen mask is a very nice product; I shared it with my aunt, and she has taken it from me now.
The collagen mask is a brilliant product, and I will definitely recommend it to friends. A little goes a long way, so hopefully it will last a while.
I have used the collagen mask twice. It has a lovely, refreshing texture and left my skin soft and glowing. I am adding it to my routine now.
The collagen mask has a pleasant smell without being overpowering, and my skin felt great after just one use.
The collagen mask is a brilliant product with instructions that are very easy to follow.
The collagen mask is easy to apply and left my skin feeling revitalized; my makeup applied much more easily afterward.
I have used the collagen mask a few times now, and my skin feels very soft and refreshed after each use. It also looks brighter.

I have used the collagen mask twice now. It went on smoothly and smelled lovely. Each time, my skin felt tight with the product. I cleansed it off in the morning. It is too early to tell if it is working, but it is a lovely part of my weekly routine.
I used the collagen mask several times overnight, and my skin is smoother and feels softer. It is easy to use and has a lovely smell.
I have only used the collagen mask once, but I am really happy with it so far. I love that it is left on overnight. My skin feels wonderful the next morning.
I love this collagen mask; it makes my skin feel soft and hydrated.
The collagen mask is a nice product; it did not overwhelm my skin or cause any oily breakouts. My skin feels softer and more hydrated.
I loved this collagen mask! The smell was amazing. It has a very smooth texture and sinks into the skin well. The following morning my skin felt smooth and soft. I would definitely buy it again.
It smelled lovely and was nice to apply, but I did not notice any difference to my skin at all. I probably would not buy the collagen mask again unless it was on offer.
This is my favorite mask; my skin felt so moisturized after using the collagen mask, and I would definitely recommend it.

The collagen mask has excellent high-end packaging and a gorgeous aqua-marine color. The mask is very easy to apply and feels great on the skin; you can really feel it working. After washing off the mask, my face felt lovely and rejuvenated. I highly recommend it.

The collagen mask is an amazing product that smells divine and goes on well. There is no stickiness or grease, as it sinks into the skin and dries quickly. It washes off well and leaves my skin feeling silky and fresh. I even get it on my hands, and there has been a significant improvement in them as well; they feel much more hydrated.
The collagen mask has a nice texture and leaves a nice glow. However, the perfume is a little heavy, and there are not many organic elements in it.
The collagen mask is lovely to apply and left my skin feeling soft and smooth.

The collagen mask is a really good product; from the first application, you can feel that your skin is hydrated and smooth. The smell is really good too and reminded me of passion fruit, which I love. I will keep using it!
The collagen mask gave really good results; my skin felt lovely after using it.
I love this collagen mask. I have been using it daily and will continue to do so. It made my skin so soft and my wrinkles less prominent.

I have dry skin and love a peel-off mask. While searching for one, I received an email about these masks. I chose the collagen mask for anti-aging and to add volume to my skin. It is not my preferred type of mask, but it washes off easily. It feels somewhat drying while it is on, but not tight. My skin feels softer after each use, but otherwise, I cannot pinpoint a difference in my skin's appearance.
